{{Top|leg}}
'''Sanyassan''' was the native language of the [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassans]], a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Sanyassa IV]]. It featured growls, guttural snarls, and shrieks.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Most Sanyassans were fluent in both Sanyassan language and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], but only literate in their own language.<ref name="EndorModdell">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]] also learnt this language after she joined with the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a group of pillagers led by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]].<ref name="bfe">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> According to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Pfilbee Jhorn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Sanyassan language was written using a [[Sanyassan hieroglyphs|hieroglyphic system]].<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sanyassan language was heard in several scenes from the [[1985]] made-for-TV film ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]'', notably during a discussion between King Terak and the Nightsister Charal. According to the movie credits, the Sanyassan dialogues were created by [[Mari Mine-Rutka]].<ref name="bfe" />
